researchError.unknownOutcome.source: This request may already have been handled. Keep its original recovery record; do not submit or sign again automatically.
researchError.unknownOutcome.text: 此请求可能已处理。保留原恢复记录；不要自动再次提交或签名。

researchError.checkStatusAfter.source: Check service status again in {seconds}s. Requests will not retry automatically.
researchError.checkStatusAfter.text: {seconds} 秒后再次检查服务状态。请求不会自动重试。

maintenance.held.source: Maintenance status reports new requests held
maintenance.held.text: 维护状态报告新请求暂停

maintenance.overrun.source: Expected maintenance end has passed; requests remain held
maintenance.overrun.text: 预计维护结束时间已过；请求仍暂停

maintenance.controlUnavailable.source: Maintenance controls unavailable; requests remain held
maintenance.controlUnavailable.text: 维护控制不可用；请求仍暂停

maintenance.expectedEnd.source: Expected end (UTC), not a reopening guarantee: {endsAt}
maintenance.expectedEnd.text: 预计结束时间（UTC），不保证重新开放：{endsAt}

maintenance.healthUnknown.source: Application health is not probed by this status endpoint.
maintenance.healthUnknown.text: 此状态端点不探测应用健康。

maintenance.refreshEnded.source: Automatic public status refresh has ended. Check service status for a newer observation.
maintenance.refreshEnded.text: 自动公开状态刷新已结束。检查服务状态以获得较新观察。

maintenance.noRetry.source: Research requests and signatures will not retry automatically. Keep existing recovery records.
maintenance.noRetry.text: 研究请求及签名不会自动重试。保留现有恢复记录。

account.introduction.source: Sign in to research, publish sources, and manage your account. Your wallet holds your USDC; you choose how much the agent can spend.
account.introduction.text: 登录以研究、发布来源及管理账户。钱包持有 USDC；您决定代理能花多少。

account.signOutUnconfirmed.source: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Please retry.

account.checkingReturn.text: 正在检查登录返回上下文...

account.networkInstruction.source: Keryx runs on {network} (chainId {chainId}). Switch to continue.
account.networkInstruction.text: Keryx 运行于 {network}（chainId {chainId}）。切换以继续。

account.walletInstruction.source: Choose your browser wallet. {network} will be added automatically if not already configured.
account.walletInstruction.text: 选择浏览器钱包。若未配置，将自动添加 {network}。

account.signatureInstruction.source: Sign a message in your wallet to prove ownership. No gas required — this is a signature, not a transaction.
account.signatureInstruction.text: 在钱包签署消息以证明所有权。无需 gas；这是签名，不是交易。

account.registrationWalletMismatch.source: This registration draft belongs to the wallet that started sign-in. Switch back to that wallet or {restartLink}.
account.registrationWalletMismatch.text: 此注册草稿属于开始登录的钱包。切回该钱包或{restartLink}。

accountSessions.introduction.source: Review account access across browsers. Each sign-in creates a session; device names and locations are not collected.
accountSessions.introduction.text: 审阅跨浏览器账户访问。每次登录创建会话；不收集设备名及位置。

accountSessions.signOutBoundary.source: Signing out ends account access. It does not cancel accepted research jobs or already signed payment authorizations.
accountSessions.signOutBoundary.text: 退出结束账户访问，不取消已接受研究任务或已签名付款授权。

accountSessions.truncated.source: Showing the 100 newest sessions. Sign out all other sessions also includes older sessions.
accountSessions.truncated.text: 显示最新 100 个会话。“退出所有其他会话”也包括较早会话。

accountSessions.ended.source: Your session has ended. Sign in again to manage sessions.
accountSessions.ended.text: 会话已结束。重新登录管理会话。

accountSessions.refreshFailed.source: Sessions could not be refreshed. Please retry.

accountSessions.selectedSignedOut.source: The selected session has been signed out.

accountSessions.othersSignedOut.source: Other sessions have been signed out. This session remains active.
accountSessions.othersSignedOut.text: 其他会话已退出。此会话仍有效。

accountSessions.signOutUnconfirmed.source: Sign-out could not be confirmed. Refresh the list and retry.
accountSessions.signOutUnconfirmed.text: 无法确认退出。刷新列表并重试。

researchEntry.question.source: What do you want to know?

researchEntry.placeholder.source: Ask a question worth reading for...
researchEntry.placeholder.text: 提出值得阅读以解答的问题...

researchEntry.keyboardHint.source: Enter for a new line · Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to ask
researchEntry.keyboardHint.text: Enter 换行 · Ctrl/⌘ + Enter 提问

researchEntry.metadataLookupLabel.source: Look up free paper metadata: title, authors or DOI
researchEntry.metadataLookupLabel.text: 查找免费论文元数据：标题、作者或 DOI

researchEntry.deepHint.source: Deep: up to 4 reads, including marketplace discovery and a coverage check.
researchEntry.deepHint.text: Deep：最多 4 次阅读，包括市场发现及覆盖检查。

researchEntry.sessionNotice.source: Your research budget pays on {network}. This question can use up to {amount} USDC; your remaining total also applies.
researchEntry.sessionNotice.text: 您的研究预算在 {network} 付款。此问题最多可用 {amount} USDC；还受剩余总额限制。

researchEntry.unavailableSessionNotice.source: Session status unavailable. Recover your funded session below before another question.
researchEntry.unavailableSessionNotice.text: 会话状态不可用。再次提问前恢复下方已注资会话。

researchEntry.expiredSessionNotice.source: Session expired. Recover it below before another wallet funded question.
researchEntry.expiredSessionNotice.text: 会话已过期。再次由钱包资助提问前在下方恢复。

researchEntry.sponsoredNotice.source: Sponsored trial on {network}. No wallet or deposit required. Usage and spending limits apply.
researchEntry.sponsoredNotice.text: {network} 赞助试用。无需钱包或存款。适用使用及支出限制。

researchEntry.scholarly.text: 搜索学术论文（Crossref 和 arXiv）

researchEntry.scholarlyNotice.source: Sends your question to scholarly repositories. DOI lookup works when a DOI is in the question. Public papers cost no source USDC; unavailable papers and abstract-only reads stay visible.
researchEntry.scholarlyNotice.text: 将问题发送给学术资料库。问题含 DOI 时可查询 DOI。公开论文不花来源 USDC；不可用论文及仅摘要阅读保持可见。

researchEntry.paidScholarly.source: Include reviewed paid manuscripts (experimental testnet rights protocol)
researchEntry.paidScholarly.text: 包含已审核付费稿件（实验性测试网权利协议）

researchEntry.paidScholarlyMainnetNotice.source: Paid manuscript rights are not yet available on mainnet. Ordinary registered articles remain available.
researchEntry.paidScholarlyMainnetNotice.text: 主网尚不可用付费稿件权利。普通注册文章仍可用。

researchEntry.paidScholarlyNotice.source: Requires your funded browser session. Uses the question budget for access and supported citation rewards. Public scholarly references stay free; only approved exact versions can be paid.
researchEntry.paidScholarlyNotice.text: 需已注资浏览器会话。使用问题预算支付访问和获支持引用奖励。公开学术参考仍免费；仅获批确切版本可付款。

researchEntry.budgetNotice.source: The agent cannot spend more than this amount on one question. Choose 0 for free sources without source purchases or creator rewards. Model and search costs remain separate.
researchEntry.budgetNotice.text: 代理对单个问题不能超此金额支出。选择 0 使用免费来源，无来源购买或创作者奖励。模型及搜索成本仍独立。

researchEntry.searchNotice.source: Research may search the public web; your question is sent to our search provider. The USDC source budget is separate from model and search operating costs.
researchEntry.searchNotice.text: 研究可能搜索公开网络；问题发送给搜索服务商。USDC 来源预算独立于模型及搜索运营成本。

researchEntry.sqliteExample.source: Compare SQLite WAL and rollback journals
researchEntry.sqliteExample.text: 比较 SQLite WAL 与回滚日志

researchEntry.educationExample.text: 研究儿童教育视频创意

ledgerHistory.rankingNotice.source: Ranked by settled access and citation payments to each original source and wallet. Historical listings do not establish current publisher control.
ledgerHistory.rankingNotice.text: 按向各原来源及钱包的已结算访问和引用付款排名。历史来源信息不确立当前出版者控制。

ledgerHistory.allEntries.text: 显示全部 {count} 个来源 / 钱包条目

ledgerHistory.emptyCreators.source: No settled creator payments in this snapshot.
ledgerHistory.emptyCreators.text: 此快照无已结算创作者付款。

ledgerHistory.evidenceLabel.text: 历史 Arc 测试网证据

ledgerHistory.period.source: Recorded reading and creator payments from {from} to {to}. Original testnet evidence is retained alongside current mainnet activity.
ledgerHistory.period.text: {from} 至 {to} 的阅读及创作者付款记录。原测试网证据与当前主网活动并存保留。

ledgerHistory.historicalNotice.source: Testnet USDC, separate from mainnet. Includes owner-operated activity; these totals do not establish independent customers or event-period growth.
ledgerHistory.historicalNotice.text: 测试网 USDC，独立于主网。含所有者操作活动；总额不确立独立客户或活动期增长。

ledgerHistory.creatorUnavailable.text: 测试网创作者排行榜暂不可用。

ledgerHistory.serviceReceipts.text: 服务收款（独立于创作者付款）

ledgerHistory.settledRecordsSuffix.text: 条记录 · 已结算金额

ledgerHistory.snapshotNotice.source: Snapshot captured {capturedAt}. Settlement states are frozen at capture time. Wallets and channels are recorded identities, not independent people.
ledgerHistory.snapshotNotice.text: 快照捕获于 {capturedAt}。结算状态冻结于捕获时间。钱包和渠道是已记录身份，不是独立人数。

ledger.title.text: 阅读活动及创作者奖励

ledger.introduction.source: Follow the questions, explore the sources, and see what reached creator wallets. Browse the retained testnet track record and current mainnet activity, each with its original payment proof.
ledger.introduction.text: 跟踪问题、探索来源及查看创作者钱包所得。浏览保留测试网历史及当前主网活动，各自保留原付款凭证。

jobLedger.description.source: Inspect recorded public research transfers, their settlement evidence and a balanced export.
jobLedger.description.text: 查看公开研究转账记录、结算证据及平衡导出。

jobLedger.introduction.source: Recorded transfers for completed public web dispatches, with customer and Keryx funding shown separately. Questions and customer identities are omitted.
jobLedger.introduction.text: 已完成公开网页研究的转账记录，分别显示客户及 Keryx 资助。不含问题和客户身份。

jobLedger.boundary.source: This bounded, partial ledger uses separate read snapshots. It is not complete business books, a cash balance or profit. Private invoices, refunds and full purchase revenue remain unavailable.
jobLedger.boundary.text: 此有限部分账本使用独立读取快照。不是完整业务账目、现金余额或利润。私密发票、退款及完整购买收入仍不可用。

jobLedger.loading.text: 正在读取公开转账证据…

jobLedger.unavailable.source: Public transfer evidence is unavailable. The sealed read-only store may be unsupported or unavailable.
jobLedger.unavailable.text: 公开转账证据不可用。封存只读存储可能不受支持或不可用。

jobLedger.captured.source: Reads from {startedAt} to {completedAt}. Payment window starts {from}.
jobLedger.captured.text: 读取从 {startedAt} 至 {completedAt}。付款窗口始于 {from}。

jobLedger.limits.source: Up to {runs} recent public-domain runs and {payments} payment rows were inspected. Historical testnet archives are not combined with this selected store.
jobLedger.limits.text: 检查最多 {runs} 次近期公开域运行及 {payments} 条付款行。历史测试网档案不与所选存储合并。

jobLedger.limitReached.source: A scan limit was reached. Coverage remains partial.
jobLedger.limitReached.text: 已达扫描限制。覆盖仍不完整。

jobLedger.fundingBoundary.source: Browser-funded transfers are not Operator expenses. Sponsored fees are not outside-customer revenue. Outside/team customer attribution is unknown.
jobLedger.fundingBoundary.text: 浏览器资助转账不是 Operator 开支。赞助费用不是外部客户收入。外部/团队客户归属未知。

jobLedger.position.source: Cash position and obligations: unknown. Advisory safe spending: {amount}.
jobLedger.position.text: 现金状况及义务：未知。建议安全支出：{amount}。

jobLedger.profit.source: Purchase price, provider invoices, refunds and margin: unavailable.
jobLedger.profit.text: 购买价格、服务商发票、退款及利润率：不可用。

jobLedger.balance.text: 转账控制试算平衡：借方 {debit}，贷方 {credit}。

jobLedger.accounts.source: Debit increases an observed recipient-role transfer account; credit decreases an observed sender-funding-role account. These are transfer control accounts, not revenue or expense accounts.
jobLedger.accounts.text: 借方增加观察到的接收者角色转账账户；贷方减少观察到的发送方资助角色账户。这是转账控制账户，不是收入或费用账户。

jobLedger.noJobs.source: No eligible public web dispatches were observed in this bounded slice.
jobLedger.noJobs.text: 此有限片段未观察到合格公开网页研究。

jobLedger.coverage.source: Leg coverage: {coverage}. Finish-time expected recorded legs: {count}.
jobLedger.coverage.text: 环节覆盖：{coverage}。完成时预期记录环节：{count}。

jobLedger.settled.text: 有保留证据的已结算记录

jobLedger.referenceBoundary.source: Transfer references are not automatically Arc transaction hashes. The export checksum detects changes; it is not an authenticity signature or independent settlement confirmation.
jobLedger.referenceBoundary.text: 转账参考不自动等于 Arc 交易哈希。导出校验和检测变化，不是真实性签名或独立结算确认。

privateProfile.privacyBoundary.source: Only you and keys you explicitly authorize can access this profile. These fields do not verify your identity or change payment ownership.
privateProfile.privacyBoundary.text: 仅您及明确授权的密钥可访问此资料。字段不核验身份，也不更改付款所有权。

privateProfile.firstSeenAndDispatches.text: 首次出现：{firstSeen} · 归属研究：{questions}

privateProfile.creatorsPaid.source: Creator wallets with recorded settled payments in your runs ({network}): {creators}
privateProfile.creatorsPaid.text: 您的运行中有已结算付款记录的创作者钱包（{network}）：{creators}

privateProfile.checkingSignIn.text: 正在检查您的登录状态…

privateProfile.deleted.source: Profile fields deleted. Your research and payment history are retained.
privateProfile.deleted.text: 资料字段已删除。研究及付款历史保留。

privateProfile.storeUnavailable.source: Profile fields are available after this deployment enables the private profile store.
privateProfile.storeUnavailable.text: 此部署启用私密资料存储后字段可用。

privateProfile.handleRules.source: Handles use 3–32 letters, digits or underscores, begin with a letter, and are case-insensitive. Reserved names are unavailable.
privateProfile.handleRules.text: 用户名使用 3–32 个字母、数字或下划线，以字母开头，不区分大小写。保留名称不可用。

privateProfile.linksLegend.text: 链接（可选 HTTPS 资料 URL）

privateProfile.deleteConfirmation.source: Delete your private profile fields and links? Research and payment history will remain.
privateProfile.deleteConfirmation.text: 删除私密资料字段及链接？研究和付款历史仍保留。

privateProfile.activityBoundary.source: Derived from dispatches attributed to this wallet in this store, including recorded simulations in dispatch counts. Attribution does not establish who funded a run. Anonymous and historical archive activity are excluded. Up to 12 recorded topics are shown. Creator counts require recorded settlement evidence; they do not independently reconcile Circle.
privateProfile.activityBoundary.text: 源于此存储中归属此钱包的研究，研究计数含记录模拟。归属不确立谁资助运行。排除匿名及历史档案活动。显示最多 12 个记录主题。创作者计数需记录结算证据；不独立与 Circle 对账。

walletMenu.connectBoundary.source: Connecting creates your account & signs you in.
walletMenu.connectBoundary.text: 连接会创建账户并登录。

walletPicker.guidance.source: On mobile: open keryx.cc inside your wallet app's browser (MetaMask, Rabby…). On desktop: install MetaMask or Rabby, then refresh.
walletPicker.guidance.text: 移动端：在钱包应用浏览器（MetaMask、Rabby…）打开 keryx.cc。桌面端：安装 MetaMask 或 Rabby 后刷新。

googleWallet.startFailed.source: Google wallet sign-in could not start. Please try again.
googleWallet.startFailed.text: 无法开始 Google 钱包登录。请重试。

googleWallet.reconnect.text: 重新连接 Google 钱包

googleWallet.connecting.text: 正在连接 Google 钱包…

googleWallet.connected.source: Google wallet connected. Choose a research budget to continue.
googleWallet.connected.text: Google 钱包已连接。选择研究预算继续。

googleWallet.completeFailed.source: Google sign-in could not complete. Please try again.
googleWallet.completeFailed.text: Google 登录未完成。请重试。

sessionBudget.questionCap.source: Maximum per question: {amount} USDC.{gap}Shared across your conversations.
sessionBudget.questionCap.text: 每问题最高：{amount} USDC。{gap}跨对话共享。

sessionBudget.renewalFailed.source: Renewal did not complete. Your saved budget and prior payments remain recorded.
sessionBudget.renewalFailed.text: 续期未完成。保存预算及先前付款仍保留记录。

sessionBudget.pendingBoundary.source: Pending payments count against the remaining budget. Renewal keeps the existing ceiling. Stopping blocks new payments; funds stay in Gateway for your withdrawal.
sessionBudget.pendingBoundary.text: 待处理付款占用剩余预算。续期保留现有上限。停止会阻止新付款；资金留在 Gateway 供提现。

sessionBudget.mainnetIncreaseBoundary.source: Review funding and a new budget confirmation before the ceiling increases. Your per-question maximum stays the same. Native gas is extra.
sessionBudget.mainnetIncreaseBoundary.text: 上限增加前审阅注资及新预算确认。每问题最高金额不变。原生 gas 另付。

sessionBudget.testnetIncreaseBoundary.source: Deposit into your existing testnet session and confirm its new allowance.
sessionBudget.testnetIncreaseBoundary.text: 存入现有测试网会话并确认新额度。

sessionCashout.preparation.source: Original amount {amount} USDC; fee at most {fee} USDC. Recipient {recipient}. Finite burn height {height}.
sessionCashout.preparation.text: 原金额 {amount} USDC；费用最多 {fee} USDC。接收者 {recipient}。有限销毁区块高度 {height}。

sessionCashout.amountPrecision.source: Enter USDC with at most six decimals
sessionCashout.amountPrecision.text: 输入最多六位小数的 USDC 金额

sessionCashout.signInOriginalOwner.source: Sign in as the original owner to recover cashout
sessionCashout.signInOriginalOwner.text: 以原所有者身份登录恢复提现

sessionCashout.consentUnavailable.text: 保留所有者同意参考不可用

sessionCashout.reviewExceeded.source: Prepared amount or fee exceeds your review. Cancel this unsigned original before preparing again.
sessionCashout.reviewExceeded.text: 准备金额或费用超出审阅值。再次准备前取消此未签名原请求。

sessionCashout.attemptExists.source: An original transfer attempt exists; use recovery
sessionCashout.attemptExists.text: 存在原转账尝试；请使用恢复

sessionCashout.transferSubmitted.text: 转账已提交；需原请求恢复

sessionCashout.completedWithFinality.source: completed with original mainnet mint finality
sessionCashout.completedWithFinality.text: 原主网铸币最终性确认后完成

sessionCashout.cancelledBeforeExposure.source: cancelled before exposure; original ID retained
sessionCashout.cancelledBeforeExposure.text: 暴露前已取消；原 ID 保留

sessionCashout.interruptedSigningCancell.source: interrupted signing cancelled; original retained. Prepare a new withdrawal or renew your Session to resume research.
sessionCashout.interruptedSigningCancell.text: 中断签名已取消；原请求保留。准备新提现或续期会话以恢复研究。

sessionCashout.walletUnavailable.source: Original cashout and owner wallet unavailable
sessionCashout.walletUnavailable.text: 原提现及所有者钱包不可用

sessionCashout.mintSubmitted.text: 所有者铸币已提交；最终性待确认

sessionCashout.enterMintHash.source: Enter the original owner mint transaction hash
sessionCashout.enterMintHash.text: 输入原始所有者铸造交易哈希

sessionCashout.custodyBoundary.source: Recipient is your original owner wallet. Research pauses while a withdrawal is unresolved. Signed payments and uncertain transfers remain held; gas is paid separately by your owner wallet. Logout and grant expiry retain this browser's recovery key.
sessionCashout.custodyBoundary.text: 接收者为原所有者钱包。提现未解决期间研究暂停。签名付款及不确定转账仍预留；所有者钱包另付 gas。退出及授权过期保留此浏览器恢复密钥。

sessionCashout.recoveryBoundary.source: If signing was interrupted before a burn signature was saved, cancel interrupted signing to unlock recovery. This also works after the original expires. A saved signature or transfer attempt requires original recovery.
sessionCashout.recoveryBoundary.text: 若保存销毁签名前签名中断，取消中断签名以解锁恢复。原请求过期后也适用。保存签名或转账尝试需要原请求恢复。

sessionCashout.prepare.source: Prepare reviewed amount and fee ceiling
sessionCashout.prepare.text: 准备已审阅金额及费用上限

sessionCashout.reviewMint.source: Review owner wallet mint and gas
sessionCashout.reviewMint.text: 审阅所有者钱包铸币及 gas

withdrawalAccount.connectInstruction.source: Connect the wallet you signed in with to review or sign a withdrawal.
withdrawalAccount.connectInstruction.text: 连接登录所用钱包以审阅或签署提现。

apiKeys.rawKeyWarning.source: This key will {neverAgain}. Store it in your secrets manager. If it is compromised, revoke it immediately from this dashboard.
apiKeys.rawKeyWarning.text: 此密钥将{neverAgain}。保存在机密管理器。若泄露，立即从此仪表板撤销。

apiKeys.introduction.source: Wallet-issued API keys for programmatic access to{endpointGap}{endpoint} and explicitly scoped account operations. Research still requires x402 {signature} per call.
apiKeys.introduction.text: 钱包签发 API 密钥用于程序访问{endpointGap}{endpoint}及明确限定范围的账户操作。研究仍需每次调用提供 x402 {signature}。

apiKeys.compatibilityInstruction.source: Any OpenAI SDK or tool works — set the base URL to{urlGap}{url} and model{modelGap}{model}. Free to try with no key; pass a{keyGap}{key} key as the Bearer token for wallet-based limits. All keys for one wallet share 10 sponsored calls per minute across chat and Remote MCP; caller IP and shared service limits also apply. Creating more keys adds no allowance. Every cited creator is paid in USDC on Arc. With{streamGap}{stream} the agent's live buy/skip/trust reasoning arrives as {reasoning}.
apiKeys.compatibilityInstruction.text: 任何 OpenAI SDK 或工具均可使用：设置基础 URL 为{urlGap}{url}，模型为{modelGap}{model}。无需密钥即可免费尝试；以{keyGap}{key}密钥作为 Bearer 令牌获得钱包限额。同一钱包所有密钥在聊天和远程 MCP 间共享每分钟 10 次赞助调用；还受调用者 IP 和共享服务限制。创建更多密钥不增加额度。每个被引用创作者在 Arc 上以 USDC 获付款。使用{streamGap}{stream}时，代理实时购买/跳过/信任推理以 {reasoning} 到达。
